verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right flow (brand/headline left, details/badges/CTA centre, product in the circle right) and a readable headline and CTA. Flaws: the missing-asset placeholder overlaps the circle edge, the 'FREE ENTRY' text is cramped, the footer is tiny, and the logo is small. B has a mis-ordered hierarchy: the tagline sits above and apart from the headline, and 'Sessions' crowds the pills. The RSVP CTA is shrunk into a tiny pill in a row with the badges, so it is buried. The 'Reserve a spot' text is tiny, the legal text is cramped, the product is small and cut off at the top right, and the layout looks scattered.
